meta.title: Industries
meta.description: Industrial sectors where Italian manufacturing capability meets East African procurement demand.

hero.title: Sectors where Italian capability meets East African demand.
hero.text: ItalBridge focuses on industrial sectors with defined procurement activity in East Africa and matching manufacturing capability in Italy. Each sector has a clear path from requirement to delivered equipment.
hero.imageAlt: Bottling line conveyor in a factory

strip.title: Seven sectors, seven paths to delivered equipment
strip.intro: Scroll the strip to move through the sectors.
strip.label: Sectors

items.title: Plastics Manufacturing
items.text: Vertical injection moulding presses and polymer processing equipment for East African plastics manufacturers producing precision components.

items.title: Packaging
items.text: Packaging line machinery and systems for manufacturers requiring filling, sealing, and packaging automation for consumer and industrial goods.

items.title: Industrial Automation
items.text: Control systems, robotic integration, and factory automation solutions for production lines seeking efficiency and throughput gains.

items.title: Precision Components
items.text: High-precision machined components, tooling, and engineered parts for industrial applications demanding tight tolerances and reliability.

items.title: Food Processing
items.text: Stainless steel processing systems, filling lines, and food-grade manufacturing equipment for the food and beverage sector.

items.title: Construction Equipment
items.text: Equipment for producing and processing construction and building materials, supporting regional infrastructure development.

items.title: Automotive Workshop Equipment
items.text: Workshop equipment, diagnostic systems, and specialised tooling for the automotive aftermarket and vehicle service sector.

suppliers.title: Who supplies each sector
suppliers.text: Each sector is matched to a defined group of Italian manufacturers.

cta.title: Don't see your sector?
cta.text: If you manufacture or procure industrial equipment not listed here, we'd still like to talk.
